nom: belif Moisturizing Eye Bomb Eye Cream

avis.texte: This eye cream is highly moisturizing and will improve the texture under your eyes. Remember that no product is a miracle but this one in fact delivers on its promise to reduce fine lines, puffiness and make the area look smooth and hydrated!!
I originally received a small amount as a sample and noticed right away the difference.
Im not someone who has sensitive skin but this caused my undereyes to be so dry and red and made my eyes swell. I researched and this does have fragrance so if your sensitive to that i would avoid.

avis.titre: Don't use in your sleep - Migrates
avis.texte: I've been having issues with eye irritation in the middle of the night. Waking up feeling like there was stuff in my eyes. It stopped the minute I changed eye creams. This is moaitueizing, but if you have sensitive eyes, this isn't for you. It's not think enough, doesn't absorb well and migrates.

Finally an eye cream that doesn't burn my under eyes! Easy to apply and definitely hydrating. This will definitely last me a long time since you dont need to use a lot. It has definitely made a difference when I use concealer since it doesn't look cakey or flake off.

This eye cream is awesome! I've been using it at night for a few days now and my under eye concealer and makeup look so much better now during the day. The very obvious creases and wrinkles are not nearly as noticeable as before. I haven't tried it during the day under my makeup but I'm going to try it tomorrow. Either way, this stuff has helped my very dry under eye skin!
This is the only eye cream that I use. I get dry patches under my eyes and this is the only eye cream that has made them disappear. It's effective and feels so nice on the skin.
I havent used this cream yet but I love the gel with applicator. All the belief products work well for me.

I have had wrinkles under my eyes since I was a teenager. I'm now 37 and I have tried so, so many eye creams under $50. This eye cream is the only one that has not only worked, but the results keep getting better as time goes on, months later. I got a sample back in February, and I was so stunned by the results, I bought a jar in April. I have ZERO undereye wrinkles, and all discoloration has gone away. I swear, this is made of clouds and magic. It feels so soothing when applying. It doesn't overhydrate and make my skin greasy, it's perfect. My husband even noticed a difference. Bottom line, it's absolutely worth the money.

I am 47 years old, very fair skin, and live in Florida. In short, maturing skin that shows every flaw living on the surface of the sun. This has been the only eye cream that has worked so well for me I can't wait to use it every day. Firm, bright, decreased lines, and weightless.

I love the eye cream, however, the packaging is large for the amount of product. This seems very wasteful and not environmentally friendly. Disappointing. Not sure I will purchase again due to the large wasteful packaging.

avis.titre: Gave both of us eye infections
avis.texte: This eye cream gave both my mother and I big, fat, stys. Our entire upper eyelids were swollen shut. We only applied this to the undereyes at night, and still woke up with swollen eyelids. My mother's, on one eye, has now turned into a hard, visible chalazion that she will have to get surgically removed or drained. Do not recommend, it's not worth the risk.
This eye cream is the best I've tried. It's super-moisturizing and doesn't cause acne or any bad reaction around my sensitive eye area. I recommend!
This product burns my eyes and makes them water. I havent noticed a lot of results in terms on fine lines.
This product is amazing! I was looking for an eye cream because the skin around my eyes were super dry and flakey. After using this for only one night, I see such a difference!
This product is amazing! It smooths fine lines and plumps. Best eye cream I have tried in a long time. I would highly recommend it.

I heard about this cream from a friend years ago, so I bought a whole line of skin care from belif- their witch hazel toner is amazing too but this is the one item that I continuously rebuy and restock. I have now been using this product for probably 3 1/2 years. I have sensitive skin and I am 33 years old now with 2 kids under 2 and my under eyes have no noticeable signs of wrinkles and they look plump and make up glides on without issue. I love it so much i share with my husband. So pleased with this product!

I got this in a travel pack and recently I've been traveling a lot and using it more. I noticed a significant difference in the moisture in my under eyes when I use this product. It's immediately refreshing, very moisturizing, and calming to any dryer irritation you get after washing your face. I've had it for a while and I turned 30 this year and noticed that my under eyes are a lot dryer and more sensitive. I used it for the first time today after turning 30 (which was a few months ago) and my eyes feel amazing. I honestly did not do not really believe in eye cream, but now that my body is changing and I've used this product after those changes, I am 100% on board. If you're looking for an introductory eye cream to bring moisture to your under eyes and you have sensitive skin, This is the one! Also, I love every single product in my travel/sample kit from this brand. It's really great if you have combination skin and sensitive skin. 10 Out of 10 recommend!

I got this eye cream in a set of other Belif products and this is my favorite product from them. This eye cream is the best, it moisturizes and it also absorbs well. It smells good and there is no strong fragrance! I will definitely repurchase this product!

Ive tried sooo many eye creams for my dry undereye and this is the ONLY one thats ever made a difference, I stopped using ir and tried something else and within a few days went right back to this! Will never stray away again !
Eyes started to become red and dry after shortly using this product.
I love this eye cream - it's smooth, hydrating, and smells great. I am lucky not to have a lot of wrinkles or issues around my eyes yet, and I think this eye cream is part of the reason why!

avis.titre: Why did they change the formula?!
avis.texte: After years and hundreds of dollars looking for a good ice cream, I finally found this one two years ago and that I have never been more happy. It is the perfect eye cream however only giving it four stars because they recently changed the formula. So far I don't like the new consistency. The original formula was nice. I have only used this new formula a couple of times and i hope it doesn't disappoint. Would really hate to have to look for a new eye cream. :(
My skin very sensitive and not all skin care products are good for me but Eye Bomb from Belife is perfect for me skin, I feel moisturizing and refreshing. I can highly recommend it to everyone

I have a hard time generally finding a really good eye cream that I love. I'm getting older, and as that happens I'm starting to get fine lines around my eyes. That being said it is imperative to find a good eye cream to go with a good concealer, that does not settle in the creases around your eyes. And even though I have fine lines I still struggle really bad with acne and oily/combo skin. I love this eye cream because it is not super heavy, oily, greasy, or shiny. It absorbs into my skin almost instantly, so it does not move my makeup around. The texture of it is a cream, but once applied it feels almost like a gel. It is moisturizing without being heavy and I always use this before makeup application.

I was given a free sample for my review of the product Avon moisturizing Eye Bomb. I like it. It does brighten my eyes and I don't even have to use it every day. It says it last for 48 hours, which I do think is pretty accurate. I usually use it every other day. There is no strong smell, so that is nice as well. It works well, but I would suggest using it at night. It can take a while to fully absorb into the skin under the eye. If you use it in the morning then give it a little while to absorb before putting on makeup. Honestly, I prefer using it at night because it does keep my eyes bright the next morning. I have no dark circles under my eyes when I wake up.

I've been using the Belif Moisturizing Eye Bomb for a few weeks now and I'm happy with the results. This eye cream has noticeably helped reduce the appearance of wrinkles and made my eyes look a little more firm. It has a lightweight yet rich texture, providing deep hydration without feeling greasy. I appreciate that it has a subtle, non-overpowering scent. Although it's slightly heavier than some other eye creams I've tried, it absorbs well and doesn't cause any irritation. Overall, a good product for revitalizing tired eyes. 4 out of 5 stars!

avis.titre: A competitor with eye creams triple in price
avis.texte: I absolutely love this eye cream. It goes on like a water bank cream very similar to laniege but it is SO much more hydrating for hours on end. I was struggling with under eye dryness and my makeup creasing. This does not pill under makeup, you can layer it with tons of skincare and it's a great final step. Definitely would recommend to anyone younger or more mature skin alike.
The eye moisturizer made my eyes weep constantly after application. I would not recommend for someone with sensitive eyes/skin.

I received a sample of the Belif Moisturizing Eye Bomb to try for being a BzzAgent and I have to say, if I hadn't received it, I wouldn't have purchased it on my own. I had high hopes that this moisturizer would be a great addition to my beauty routine, but after using it I just didn't notice it being any different than the other products I use. It has a great texture and I like the fact that there is no strong scent, but I didn't see any specific results from using it. Not something I would have purchased on my own.

I've tried a few Belif products and I really liked the Moisturizing Eye Bomb. My eyes are hydrated, plumped and look bright and glowing in the morning. I like the ingredients and appreciate how there aren't any pore clogging ingredients which can cause milia. The moisturizer says what it's intended to do and I love how gentle it is. It's great layering it with serums as well.

The Moisturizing Eye Bomb is a standout in skincare, offering intense hydration that leaves the delicate under-eye area feeling refreshed and revitalized. Its lightweight formula absorbs quickly without greasy residue, making it ideal for both day and night use. It has ability to smooth and plump the skin, reducing the appearance of fine lines and puffiness, while its soothing properties benefit those with sensitive skin. Consistent use results in a brighter, more youthful under-eye area, showcasing the Eye Bomb's effectiveness in delivering long-lasting moisture and rejuvenation

I LOVE this eye bomb - it is super moisturizing without feeling greasy and absorbs well into the skin. I can always tell a difference when I use a different moisturizer. I love how this one feels on the skin. Absolute winner!!

avis.titre: This moisturizing eye bomb makes such a difference!
avis.texte: I am very happy with the results of the moisturizing eye bomb. My skin felt very moisturized and it didn't bother my sensitive skin at all. Getting moisture helped with the bags and dark color under my eyes also. Very happy with this product and would definitely recommend it.

One of the most important skin care routines for me is using a good eye cream. This is good and hydrating eye cream that you can use daily. My issue with this is that the product is just have too much of a fragrance for me as I have sensitivity issues and made my eyes water.

I love how thick this eye cream is. It feels like it's actually doing what it needs to do. I mean I love a lightweight cream for daytime use but at night, this bad boy is what I'm grabbing. It not only feels luxurious on application, it's actually incredible and has become one of my favorite products.

I applied the eye bomb after moisturizing my face and everything. It applied very well, but the results weren't spectacular. I used it for about 3 weeks just to get a good feel for it. The bags under my eyes reduced a bit and were a lot less dry. I probably wouldn't buy this product. It may work better for someone else.

This is a great eye cream! I have been using it in the morning before applying my makeup and also at night as part of my nightly skincare routine. It's lightweight, hydrating, and feels great on my skin. What I love is that a little goes a long way! I would highly recommend this item for anyone who is looking for a little more hydration under your eyes.
I am very much enjoying this product. When I wake up in the morning as the first thing I dab underneath my eyes and I can immediately fill the moisture and the refresh.

I have heard rave reviews about this product and have always been skeptical to try it. I am now a firm believer and going to be a regular user from now on! A little goes so far and I noticed a difference after only a week of use.
Im not sure if I am seeing a difference honestly, but I like this product. I like that it does not have a strong scent and how it feels on my skin.
I love the consistency and how moisturizing this product is! It also lays beautifully under makeup. Can't say enough good things!
This Moisturizing Eye Cream is a fantastic product that effectively hydrates and reduces puffiness. I would definitely recommend it.

I used this product on my under eye area and it left me feeling extra hydrated the next morning. My eye bags didn't look as dark, which was a very nice plus, and my concealer didn't crease like it normally does with my regular moisturizer. Would recommend!
Feels great on. Lightweight. Not sticky. Moisturizes without being too much.

This product was able to be applied very easily. It did not leave a shine or other residue like I have experienced with other eye products. However, I do not know that I can comment on its efficacy. I did not notice much of an improvement.
I really like the consistency of this product. It doesn't leave a weird film on the under eye and it super hydrating.
I was astonished with the outcome and results from using it. Skin has never felt more fresh and smooth. Absolutely loved it, as I quickly noticed its effective use.

I'm a big believer that paying for prevention is a much better plan than scrambling for a treatment. I received this product as a sample , but I will absolutely be buying another as soon as it runs out! It is smooth and cooling, and really just moisturizes and rejuvenates the gentle skin around my eyes.

avis.titre: Keeping this in my routine FOREVER
avis.texte: This is an absolutely fantastic product! It's lightweight and absorbs so quickly so my under eyes feel refreshed and hydrated all day long. After using it for a while, I've noticed less puffiness and fine lines. It also doesn't leave behind that nasty greasy residue that you get with some eye creams, which makes it perfect for both day and night use. Highly recommend for anyone seeking a reliable and effective eye cream!
I have combination skin with dark circles and so far the products felt nice not too heavy it sinks into the skin
I had the opportunity to try the moisturiser eye cream bomb. It's not greasy and it's very rapid to absorb leaving the eye contour very hydratated.

This eye cream is now a staple in my skincare routine. It gives life to my tired, dark under eyes. I have noticed that since I have been using it, my eye area looks brighter and my makeup isn't creasing as much as it used to. It's lightweight and packs a punch. Definitely will be buying more and using it again!

avis.titre: Rich moisturising eye cream you will know you always needed
avis.texte: I love how light weight yet moisturising this eye cream is . It is fast absorbing but still keeps the area around the eye greasy for while. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this product for couple of weeks now and it really does what it says keeping the area around eyes moisturised . I usually apply as part of my night routine and I love it keeps my eyes hydrated under the make up for the whole day. I wished this came in a tube instead of jar.
I really liked this and see myself using it especially in the morning. It is super lightweight but still hydrating. It leaves a nice dewey finish but is not greasy.

avis.titre: Nice feel but haven't seen the benefit yet
avis.texte: I have been using this product nightly along with my other evening skincare regimen. I do really enjoy how it feels when applying but I'm not sure if I have noticed any benefit. Also I would like to have better instructions, I even tried looking online, to know how often to apply and if it will work under eye makeup.

The Avon moisturizing eye bomb is so deeply hydrating! The skin around my eyes feel nourished and so supple. I aplly at night and wake up with refresfed eyes. And a little goes a long way! Definitely recommend!
Super hydrating and refreshing. Helps the appearance of under eye puffiness and bags. Not overly scented so a great fit for sensitive skin.
I loved using this eye moisturizer. It was extremely cooling and helped depuff my under eye area. It was not heavy like others and felt like a spa treatment.

I'm pleased to have had the opportunity to review the moisturizing eye bomb. The packaging was decent. Th3 container it comes in is such a pretty blue color. Eye catching to say the least. The product wasn't greasy to the touch or outrageous in smelling. That's good! I'm a person who doesn't deal well with "loud" smells. Overall I didn't notice too much of a difference as of yet. The jar is very small and unfortunately not alot comes with it too be able to tell for the amount of time that I used it. When they say sample size, well.. it truly was just that, a sample size. Having said that, I do feel like I would appreciate this product being a part of My daily face routine. The only thing wrong here is, the sample wasn't big enough.
I am using this eye bomb at night time it is well moistening and i feel relaxed whenever I apply it.

I love Belif skincare products, they are always so hydrating and lightweight. Non-greasy and refreshing upon application! This eye cream definitely makes me feel bomb! Applies smoothly and reduces fine lines. Would purchase over and over again! Love it

avis.titre: I highly recommend this eye cream for everyone.
avis.texte: When I first heard about this eye cream, I was skeptical. I tried countless other eye creams, all claiming to reduce puffiness and brighten under-eye circles, but none worked. However, after trying the Belif Moisturizing Eye Bomb, I am a believer. This lightweight cream instantly hydrates and refreshes the delicate skin around my eyes, leaving me looking and feeling more awake. Its blend of hydrating and soothing ingredients like comfrey leaf and lady's mantle provide a burst of moisture while reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. I also love that it's free of parabens, sulfates, and phthalates, making it safe for my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Really helped hydrate my under eyes!!
avis.texte: I used this to add an extra boost of hydration because I noticed my concealer was always cracking under my eyes! This helped it immensely! I didn't know that this was my ultimate problem. I kept thinking it was the amount of makeup I was putting on. Anyways, if you struggle with cracking concealer consider this!!!

Despite using eye cream from another brand daily (AM/PM), I have recently been suffering from dry, itchy skin on my left eyelid and around both eyes. As such, I was at my wits end and keen to try Belif's Moisturising Eye Bomb to see if it made a difference. I can truly say that the result of only ONE days use had me pleasantly surprised! After using this product literally only twice, my worst and most worrying dry patch disappeared overnight, leaving me shocked at the result. My other dry areas (that I was focusing less on), were significantly improved. Given the result together with how my eyes feel and look due to the enhanced moisturising effect of this cream, I am realising now how I had overlooked such an important need. I will definitely be looking to purchase this product and recommending to family and friends - particularly my 73-year old mom who has been on at me for years to use decent eye cream!

The lightweight gel-cream texture is very hydrating and absorbs quickly into the delicate skin around my eyes without feeling greasy. My under-eye area looks more refreshed and awake, making me feel more confident even on days when I didn't get enough sleep. I also appreciate that a little product goes a long way, so the small jar lasts a surprisingly long time.

avis.titre: Super moisturizing for my tired eyes!
avis.texte: I am always looking for a great under eye moisturizer so I was very excited to try Belif. It looks creamy and rich in the container and has a bit of a citrusy scent to it, which surprised me. I was expecting it to feel thick when I applied it under my eyes but to my surprise, it was extremely light and almost melted in immediately! After about 30 seconds, I could clearly feel the difference in the skin where I had applied Belif and the skin where I did not. It did not make my skin shiny or oily at all. Then the real test…applying my under eye concealer on top! It applied smoothly and stayed all day- this moisturizer did not affect the staying power of my concealer or cause it to crease, as many other under eye moisturizers do. I really like this product and am so glad that I found something that works for under my eyes and with my daily makeup!

This eye cream is a very light gel cream consistency and I have really enjoyed it as a daytime eye cream. Helps my makeup go on nicely and plumps up fine lines so that I don't have creasing. I can't speak for the 48hr claim, but it definitely keeps my eye area hydrated day to day while not being too heavy. The fragrance isn't necessary, but at least it's light.

SI first used this in the morning. I put on my serum and then eye bomb followed by my moisturizer after about and hour I followed up with my makeup. My foundation started to peal around my eyes. However I did feel my eyes very moisturized. I then tried it at night and felt it very cooling and like it a lot. I'll just stick to using at night without makeup.

I used this eye bomb over the course of a week. Although I didn't notice a remarkable difference, I thought it was awesome. It felt so nice going on that I looked forward to my nightly routine. I would suggest you try this for under eye issues!
I really enjoyed the feel of this eye cream. It was great at hydrating. I do prefer one that helps more with my dark circles.
I love this eye cream! It's one I've tried and will continue to repurchase. It leaves your undereye super hydrated and ready for any product you are going to put over it.

This product provided such extended under eye moisture I've struggled to find in an eye cream. At first I was hesitant about this product as it has a menthol scent and it originally made my eyes water, but I think it was because I did not expect that. After that initial shock, I loved the application and wear of this product. My under eyes felt super hydrated and I noticed an improvement of the way my makeup sat under my eyes after using this. If you are sensitive to smells, it might not be the product for you, otherwise you should definitely try it!

avis.titre: Not bad, but I didn't notice a difference.
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for a review. I really liked the smell and texture of it, but I didn't notice that it made my under eyes more hydrated. It didn't seem to bother my skin and absorbed really well. The container was fairly small, too. I probably wouldn't purchase this again as I've used other products that have worked better.

As someone who battles dark circles and puffiness daily, finding an eye cream that delivers results has been a game-changer for me. This eye bomb has a gel-cream formula that feels incredibly lightweight and refreshing on the skin. It absorbs quickly without any greasiness or heaviness, which is a huge plus for me, especially when applying my makeup. This eye cream is an absolute powerhouse when it comes to moisturizing the delicate skin around the eyes. With just a small dab, my under-eye area feels instantly plumped and hydrated, and any dryness or tightness disappears almost immediately. With consistent use, I've noticed a significant reduction in the appearance of my dark circles and puffiness. My under-eye area looks brighter, smoother, and more refreshed than ever before. I love how sleek and compact it is, making it perfect for travel or throwing in my bag for touch-ups throughout the day. I can't recommend the Moisturizing Eye Bomb enough. If you're struggling with tired, dehydrated eyes like I was, do yourself a favor and give this eye cream a try. It's a true game-changer that will leave you looking and feeling refreshed, no matter what life throws your way.

This was my first time trying the Belif Moistening Eye Bomb. I have been using it for a week now. Belif sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program in exchange for my honest review. PROS: The formula has a good thickness to it but still yet lightweight. It dries quick and no heavy scent. I have sensitive skin and no issues. It keeps my undereye well hydrated. NO CONS to report.

Belief Moisturizing Eye Bomb is a game-changer! This luxurious eye cream delivers intense hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. The lightweight gel-cream texture absorbs quickly, leaving my delicate eye area feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. After just a few uses, I noticed a significant reduction in puffiness and dark circles, and my under-eye area appeared smoother and more radiant. The formula is packed with nourishing ingredients like comfrey leaf, bilberry, and panthenol, making it perfect for sensitive skin. Say goodbye to tired eyes – this eye bomb is a must-have in my skincare routine! Five stars without a doubt.

avis.titre: Wonderful product that I would definitely buy again!
avis.texte: I like this product! It really helps moisturize under my eyes and made my skin feel very silky. I also liked the smell. It was very refreshing. A little bit of this product really goes a long way! I highly recommend it for anyone looking to refresh the skin under and around their eyes!

I've used it for a few days in a row. I usually have flaky skin around my eye area, but that seems to be clearing up a little but! I never thought I'd find something that would help! It also has a pleasant smell, which helps.

A perfect option if you're looking for an affordable eye cream. It's moisturizing but not overly thick , Love this eye cream… love the feeling of it and it glides on and settles perfectly under eye makeup. Very moisturizing

This moisturizer works great for de-puffing eyes and brightens the under eye area. I like that it goes on very lightweight and doesn't leave it greasy. I have a sensitive eye area and this doesn't cause any irritation! The container is a little wasteful though, so much plastic for such small amount of product. I did receive this in exchange for an honest review!

Here's what I loved about the belif Moisturizing Eye Bomb: Long-lasting hydration: This is a true hydrator that keeps the under-eye area feeling moisturized all day long. No more worries about dry, flaky skin! Lightweight and non-greasy: The formula absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy residue, making it a great choice for even oily skin types. Thank you for the opportunity to try this product and leave my honest feedback :)

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: With this product, you definitely don't need a lot. The product is creamy and feels nice on my skin. I have sensitive skin and this definitely works with mine!

avis.titre: Around eye area to go from now on
avis.texte: I really liked this eye moisturizer as ita consistency is really light weight but seems to do the job. It helped reduce puffiness in the aerea especially in the morning and hydrates the area without any greasy residue.

avis.titre: LOVE IT! Best eye moisturizer ever!!
avis.texte: The absolute best eye moisturizer ever!! I can't recommend this product enough! Feels amazing, smells amazing and looks amazing! It is now a must have in my nightly routine! I promise this product will make you fall in love. I wish I had tried it sooner! Don't miss out, worth every penny!! Thank you so much!!

Belif sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. I really enjoyed using this eye moisturizer! It was very lightweight and easily absorbed into the skin. When put it on at night, my eyes still feel plump and soft. For those who don't mind fragrance, I enjoyed the floral scent. But those who have sensitive skin may have to avoid this because the scent is pretty strong. I would definitely purchase the full sized item

I am loving this eye cream so much. It's super hydrating and is suitable for day or night use. I tested it under my makeup and it performed very well. Really impressed by this product. The only thing is that I wish it was fragrance free.

avis.titre: Hydrating for delicate under eye skin.
avis.texte: I received this product as a gift for my honest opinion. I was dealing with very dry skin in the corner of my eyes, and the product did a great job of healing the irritated the skin and also keeping it hydrated and moisturized. I did not feel any burning from applying the product to my eyes which happens with other non-eye moisturizers I have used.

Omg!! I LOVE this eye cream! I received a free sample from Ulta Beauty. It was a generous size sample that I could use over 3 days. I love how quickly this eye cream melts and sinks into your skin. Very comfortable because it does not leave a greasy film after absorbing fully. I can visibly see a difference in the hydration under my eyes. The moisture plumps my fine lines and wrinkles. Everything I've tried from this brand has seemed to work for me very well. I'm definitely going to purchase a full size. I highly recommend you try this for yourself, especially if you have experience dry under your eyes. I do think that it helps with the puffiness as well. I think this is an affordable brand. This is a Korean brand that I definitely can't live without.

For people who have dry eyes all around, this is PERFECT for them!! You got this eye cream because my eyes were dry and my first day of using it my eyes were fully moisturized when I woke up. and the best part is it's safe to put all around your eye. It works very well. Doesn't have any bad odor or anything like that

i was on a search for a new eye cream. i use belif as my moisturizer and i love it so i decided to give the eye cream a try. currently still testing it but i have been loving it so far. as of so far, i have been loving it since i feel hydrated
Im over 40 and have used lots of eye creams over the years. This eye cream helps your under skin not look crepey and it sits well under make up after tou let it "dry".

Definitely one the best eye creams i've ever used! I purchased a set that included a moisturizer, aqua balm, and this eye cream. I am obsessed! I absolutely love this eye cream. It's cooling, smells great, and is extremely effective. I'm a big fan on this brand and this product is a necessity to your skincare routine!
